policy_name: F1A Major Cycle Recovery Filesystem Access Policy

transitive_access_rule.condition: The exact file or directory path must be explicitly referenced by an already allowed authority file and must be required by the F1A task.
transitive_access_rule.directory_listing: Only the exact referenced directory may be listed non-recursively.

permitted_operations: list an exact allowed directory non-recursively
run tests using exact test paths
write only under the authorized F1A major-cycle output root
modify only exact Builder implementation/test files resolved by authority
forbidden_operations: recursive globbing from the repository root
opening or listing any frozen_guarded tree
reading files merely to determine whether they match a search

development_gold_rule.purpose: Development scoring only after Implementation Freeze Seal
